provenance.method: NECB 2025 verified against the building-codes MCP server (necb:2025). The 2025 loads data is IDENTICAL to 2020: Table A-8.4.3.2.(2)-B retrieved in full for both editions and compared row-by-row (all 89 space functions: occupant density, receptacle, SWH, schedule letters, illuminance equal; only headers reformatted and the 'Parent Space Type' column dropped); schedule set A-8.4.3.2.(1)(b)-A cell-verified identical to 2020's A-8.4.3.2.(1)-A. This vintage therefore SHARES the 2020 data tables (space_types_2020.json / schedules_2020.json).

changes_vs_2020.schedule_tables_renumbered: A-8.4.3.2.(1)-A..K -> A-8.4.3.2.(1)(b)-A..K (Article 8.4.3.2 restructured into clauses in 2025)

articles.title: Thermal Blocks
articles.how: thermal-block/zoning decisions belong to the modeller or the HVAC autozoning layer, not the loads pass

articles.title: Operating Schedules, Internal Loads, Service Water Heating Loads and Set-point Temperature
articles.how: sentences (1)-(2) via NECB space-type data (2025 values verified identical to 2020; schedule citations renumbered to A-8.4.3.2.(1)(b)): occupancy + receptacle densities and NECB-<letter> schedule sets applied per space type; ventilation OA and space-type infiltration applied from the same records
articles.gaps: lighting power + lighting schedules provided by the openstudio-lighting gem (apply it after apply_loads); service-water-heating loads + SWH schedules provided by the openstudio-shw gem (apply_shw after apply_loads); illuminance levels are lighting-design data (not modelled); semi-heated set-point-from-specifications not implemented

articles.title: Air Leakage
articles.how: implemented in the openstudio-envelope gem; the loads pass applies only the space-type modelling infiltration

articles.title: HVAC System Operation
articles.how: fan/system operating schedules ship in the schedule sets; wiring them to systems is the openstudio-hvac / umbrella layer

articles.title: Simulation Parameters (Table 8.4.3.5.)
articles.gaps: simulation-parameter table not enforced by this gem; the openstudio-necb umbrella controls run parameters
